reason: A DeepSeek Harness provider plugin that connects Grok subscription accounts through Host-managed OAuth, exposes Grok chat and search capabilities, and optionally generates workspace images.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Grok 订阅账户，提供 OAuth 登录、聊天、搜索以及可选的图像生成功能。
summaries.en: Connects Grok subscription accounts to DeepSeek Harness with OAuth sign-in, chat, search, and optional image generation.

capabilities: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with the xAI Grok subscription service
Performs Host-owned OAuth PKCE sign-in and stores a session file
Sends chat requests with function tools and server-side web and X search
Retrieves model catalogs and subscription usage from xAI-related endpoints
Optionally generates images and saves them to the workspace attachment store
